text:
ana: saw a weird cluster of websocket reconnects in ap-south after we promoted the new routing-mesh. spike lasted ~10m, reconnect rate ~2.8x. some clients ended up with multiple session starts. anyone else digging?
tom: yup, traces show a burst of resume failures with "resumption_hash_mismatch" and then immediate new session opens. linked trace: /traces/stream/199001
jyoti: i think the route migration moved endpoints between availability zones quickly; session tombstones were GC'd on the old side before new side accepted tokens.
nana: small log sample:
```text
2026-05-10T01:04:11Z WARN resume failed id=rt:asia:gh45 reason=resumption_hash_mismatch
2026-05-10T01:04:12Z INFO new session created sid=abc-1001 client=23.45.67.89
```
carlos: were tokens single-use? we recently tightened to one-use + short TTL to reduce replay. that makes migrations brittle.
nana: yes, token TTL=30s, single-use. rollout applied route-gen bump + token-issuer bump in same wave. race window opened.
tom: mitigation we did: paused the rollout and extended token TTL to 120s for region. alerts-bot flagged it and we rolled the config back at 01:07.
deploy-bot: rollout paused: routing-mesh v3 -> 2026-05-10T01:06:58Z
alerts-bot: reconnect spike detected AP-SOUTH 01:05:30Z - magnitude 2.8x - alertID ALRT-7782
jyoti: short-term patch idea: accept tokens issued by previous issuer id for a 60s grace window. that buys safety for migrations without reverting strictness permanently.
carlos: agree. but we should instrument how often the backward-accept is used, otherwise it's a silent weakening. add metric stream.resume.grace_accepted and stream.resume.rejected_legacy.
nana: console/UX ask: can we show a "migration risk" banner when toggling both token-issuer and route-gen in the same rollout? product might want a confirmation modal.
tom: yes, the console currently only shows config diffs. we should add behavioral heuristics. sample heuristic: if token_issuer changes && routing-table change && token_ttl_delta < -10s then risk=HIGH.
jyoti: ops request: a canary gate that watches stream.resume.grace_accepted rate during canary. if >0.5% pause rollout and alert. ticket SRE-2345.
carlos: billing impact: some tenants received new-session billing events. pinging billing-bot to track credits. @billing-bot
billing-bot: created BILL-305 provisional adjustments queued. tagging support for manual review.
tom: long-term: decouple resume token from ephemeral instance ids. use a namespace with stable verifier keys and include rotation epochs that are accepted for +/-1 epoch. also add a token usage audit log so we can reconcile duplicate-charge cases.
jyoti: also recommend we add a preflight simulator in the rollout pipeline: simulate token rotation + zone route switch + idle-timeout delta to detect this pattern. small harness.
nana: create console metric mapping so product can see estimated financial risk per-rollout. link created: https://redwood/console/rollouts/risk-sim
nana: i'll draft incident note with timeline + remediation steps and postmortem stub. please paste short facts here and i'll assemble. :memo:
